findings.passage: REMINDER: Voter ID is required to vote in North Carolina. Voters will be asked to show photo ID when voting in person or to include a copy of their photo ID if voting by mail. Most voters will simply show their driver’s license, but there are many other acceptable photo IDs. If a voter cannot show an acceptable photo ID when voting in person, they can still vote by filling out an ID Exception Form.
findings.note: Voter-information notice on her 2026 campaign site (the page is marked as paid for by her campaign). It describes the current NC rules: photo ID in person, a copy of photo ID with a mail ballot, and an ID Exception Form for a voter without ID. It describes the law and does not say whether she favors it. Exact page date not shown.
subjects: voters with no ID (ID exception form)

findings.passage: North Carolinians deserve free and fair elections, where voters choose their representatives, not the other way around.
